params.body:
The README gets the Forge deploy badge and the tests badge at the top, and its text catches up with the cutover of 2026-09-15: production on traders.stocklistdealer.eu is deployed from this repository (the staging row on on-forge.com is gone), the Cutover section speaks in the past tense, and the sibling repos are listed under their new names (`website`, `stockcars-website`, `brand`).

`CUTOVER.md` ticks the "replace README" item in the aftercare list.

Documentation only, no code.
params.title: README: deploy and test badges, and the text after the cutover
